items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I had a dream that Buck Clayton and all of them were sitting up in the balcony

ctx.x: Well, I don't know, I prayed so very hard. One thing I was very happy that I became Catholic because their liturgy and what they preach teach you about everyday life if you catch on to it. You're never unhappy if you pay attention to what you read and what's said in the Gospels. One thing that happened with me when I was praying, I remember reading little pamphlets - every thing in the church I'd sit and read it and I never studied so hard in all my life, as far as reading. I'd pray for the souls in purgatory.…
